[CR CR1285 for 36.423] Reason for change: Back at RAN3 #87, a list of causes for Dual connectivity was compiled and agreed. These causes are applicable to EN-DC, too. Since at RAN3 #102 it was agreed that “Dual Connectivity” does not cover EN-DC, the current description of the causes does not cover EN-DC. Summary of change: “EN-DC” is added to the description of the relevant causes. Impact assessment towards the previous version of the specification (same release): This CR has isolated impact with the previous version of the specification (same release) because it affects only limited set of procedures in compatible way. Consequences if not approved: Following the decision at RAN3 #102, it would not be possible to use dual connectivity causes in EN-DC.

{"chunk_id":"R3-205255-header","collection":"ran3_cr_chunks","metadata":{"source":"Samsung","specNumber":"36.423","tdocNumber":"R3-205255","title":"Correction on the Maximum Number of CHO Preparations in X2AP"},"point_id":"5640191085682971393"}
[CR CR1537 for 36.423] Reason for change: In the RAN3#107bis-e meeting, RAN3 agreed on setting Max Number of CHO Preparations to 8 for NR, to align with the case of RRC, RAN2’s decision in the RAN2#109-e. The value in LTE should also be aligned with the case of RRC. Also, some IEs in ASN.1 are missing. Summary of change: Max Number of CHO Preparations has been changed from 16 to 8, aligned with the RAN2’s decision. Missing IE for the HANDOVER CANCEL message in ASN.1 is filled. Impact assessment towards the previous version of the specification (same release): This CR has an impact on the messages containing IE relating maximum number of cells for CHO, and the change is non-backward compatible. Consequences if not approved: The value is not aligned with the case of RRC decided by RAN2.

[CR CR0032r3 for 38.425] Reason for change: In order to allow the node hosting the NR PDCP to take an appropriate decision on when to activate or deactivate PDCP duplication in DL, it is opportune to allow the corresponding node to provide assistance infromation in the form of measurements of DL radio link quality Summary of change: A new PDU Type is defined for assistance information, which includes radio quality assistance information Revision 3: Implementing agreed text proposal in R3-183530 and R3-183578. Consequences if not approved: DL PDCP duplication activation cannot be triggered in a fast and reliable way depending on DL radio conditions.

documents.text: [CR CR0032r3 for 38.425] Reason for change: In order to allow the node hosting the NR PDCP to take an appropriate decision on when to activate or deactivate PDCP duplication in DL, it is opportune to allow the corresponding node to provide assistance infromation in the form of measurements of DL radio link quality Summary of change: A new PDU Type is defined for assistance information, which includes radio quality assistance information Revision 3: Implementing agreed text proposal in R3-183530 and R3-183578. Consequences if not approved: DL PDCP duplication activation cannot be triggered in a fast and reliable way depending on DL radio conditions.

[CR CR0660 for 38.473] Reason for change: In the RAN3#107bis-e meeting, RAN3 agreed on setting Max Number of CHO Preparations to 8 for NR, to align with the case of RRC, RAN2’s decision in the RAN2#109-e. This is reflected only in messages and IEs in XnAP. The value used in F1AP should also be aligned with the case of RRC. Summary of change: Max Number of CHO Preparations has been changed from 16 to 8, aligned with the value in XnAP. Impact assessment towards the previous version of the specification (same release): This CR has an impact on the messages containing IE relating maximum number of cells for CHO, and the change is non-backward compatible. Consequences if not approved: The value is not aligned with the value in XnAP.

 upon receiving an official request via an incoming LS from TSGs (SA, CT, or RAN), not from other WGs. If a removal request originates from a single WG, RAN3 must escalate it to RAN Plenary to ensure TSG-level alignment and cross-TSG coordination. CR Submission & Approval: If the removal is confirmed and the corresponding RAN WI is led by RAN3, companies are encouraged to submit CRs to update the affected RAN3 specifications. If such feature removal also has impact on other WGs, the complete CR sets (e.g., WGx CR submitted and the linked WGy CRs are also needed) should be submitted and approved at the same TSG meeting. All related CRs are supposed to be finalized within one quarter. WI Summary Alignment: For confirmed removals in RAN3-led WI, the RAN3 Chair should task the WI rapporteur to review the pre-release WI summary in the initial release (e.g., TR 21.917 for R17 features, managed by SA) to ensure consistency. WI summary updates should be addressed and approved in TSG meetings. Opt1: The above proposed process for RAN3 on Pre-Release Feature Removal is proposed to be captured in TR30.531. On the other hand, if companies would like to to consider such feature removal on a case by case basis, then the below proposal is proposed. Opt2: The following text is proposed to be captured in Chair minutes in AI8.1: TSG RAN WG3 should not reopen pre-release feature removal on the R17/R18 PWS for NTN feature discussions only upon receiving an official request via an incoming LS from TSGs (SA, CT, or RAN). The pre-release WI summary in the initial release (e.g., TR 21.917 for R17 features, managed by SA) needs to be updated in TSG meeting to ensure consistency if feature removal is confirmed. Considering we may face the similar case in future, and general principle can be made to avoid to repeat the process discussion. We would like to suggest to adopt Opt1. Proposal: RAN3 to discuss and adopt the corresponding option to resolve the pre-release feature removal issue. Following is our proposal and text for TR30.531 in Opt1: Opt1: The above proposed process for RAN3 on Pre-Release Feature Removal is proposed to be captured in TR30.531.
